## 本次更新

- 新增 Wear OS 手表端独立目标（`wearos`）与 Wear Material 3 界面适配：提供圆屏页签导航、全圆封面底图与环形播放进度、滚动歌词、播放队列弹层、单列推荐/排行榜/搜索/歌单页面、手表原生开关与滚轮设置表单，以及手机扫码登录支持。
- 新增 Wear OS 发布构建产物（`-wearos-arm64-v8a.apk`、`-wearos-armeabi-v7a.apk`、`-wearos-x86_64.apk`）。

## What's new

- Adds a standalone Wear OS target (`wearos`) with native Wear Material 3 screens: watch tab navigation, a full-bleed blurred cover player with a circular progress ring, scrolling lyrics, a queue sheet, single-column For You / Charts / Search / Playlist lists, watch-native settings switches and pickers, and phone-scanned QR sign-in.
- Publishes standalone Wear OS APK artifacts (`-wearos-arm64-v8a.apk`, `-wearos-armeabi-v7a.apk`, `-wearos-x86_64.apk`).
